findings.text: The retry limit of one extra pass over exhausted routes is the literal `[false, true]` inside the search loop, while the other budget policies (`searchShare`, `shrinkShare`, `explanationShare`) are named definitions in `CheckBudget.lean`. Fix: define the retry policy as a named definition with a docstring next to `searchShare` and use it in `search`.

The docstring of `search` describes two callers ("the default SQL checker", "an interactive search") and never names the new parameter `retryExhausted` or says what each value does. Fix: state that `retryExhausted := true` gives the routes that ran out of their share one more pass with the work that is left, and that `false` gives each route one share.
